notes.title: New Kosmos Connections Demo (0.6) Release!
notes.notes:
Hello, folks!

This is just to inform you all that a new update for [i]Kosmos Connections[/i] has arrived to celebrate the Steam Visual Novel Fest taking place from August 7th through the 10th! 

Since the last demo published on Steam, the game has grown and changed for the better, and this is no more apparent than in the writing quality. The following new demo contains:

-A 25,000 word script (~2:30-3 hours of playtime)
-A rewritten prologue
-A completely rewritten Chapter 1 for Tau & Jen's routes
-A completely rewritten Chapter 1 for [i]Uplink Alethia[/i]
-New music by Marek Domagała

In the near future, I plan to include Runia's updated Chapter 1 as part of this demo, but due to wanting to get this demo out in time for the VN Fest, I needed to manage myself carefully, and that only means Tau and Jen. With that said, I hope you look forward to Runia being added in the near future, thus completing the demo's content!

I will do my best to update this page as major progress is made, but for now, all I can do is thank you for your patience, and I hope you look forward to playing the new [i]Kosmos Connections[/i] demo!
